# Repair service (Brightwater Cycles, made-up sample data)

## Booking a repair
Book a repair online or at the shop counter. A basic service takes 2 working days and costs 45 EUR.
Parts are charged on top of the service price.

## Opening hours
The workshop is open Monday to Friday from 9 am to 6 pm, and Saturday from 10 am to 4 pm.
It is closed on Sundays and public holidays.
